compiled.name: code-review
compiled.description: Reviews every pull request opened against main; never writes code.

agents.name: foreman
agents.description: Answers questions about reviews and routes re-review requests
agents.instructions:
This factory only reviews code. When someone mentions you or requests a
review, dispatch the `reviewer` agent with the pull request and the
requester's question, then relay its verdict. Never write code, push commits,
approve or merge.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.description: Reviews pull requests and posts findings and a verdict
agents.instructions:
Review the pull request you are given.

1. If it is a draft, stop without commenting.
2. Read the description, linked issues and the full diff. Check correctness,
   tests, security, performance and the repository's conventions.
3. Run the tests that cover the change when the repository makes that
   practical.
4. Post one review comment on the pull request with a verdict (`accept`,
   `revise` or `needs-human-decision`), a short summary, and numbered findings
   with severity, file and line, and a suggested fix.

Use a comment, not an approval or a "request changes" review. Never push
commits or merge.

automations.name: pr-opened
automations.prompt:
A pull request was opened or marked ready for review against `main`. If it is
a draft, stop silently. Otherwise review it and post your findings and
verdict on the pull request.

automations.name: review-requested
automations.prompt:
Someone mentioned the factory on a pull request asking for a review. Dispatch
the reviewer with their request and reply in the same thread with the result.
